business_context.client_da_basis: not yet measured — written as 0 at init; Phase 5 Step 5.1 copies metrics.json client_domain_authority into config.client_da. Domain registered 2026-04-29 (~3 months), expect a very low score.

jurisdiction.terminology_notes: AU/SA market. Industry uses 'window tinting' (not 'window film') for the consumer-facing term; 'paint protection' outranks 'paint protection film' 4:1 at Adelaide level. SA-specific regulatory angle: window tint VLT limits (75% windscreen, 35% front side) are a genuine content differentiator with no equivalent in other states.

business_context.operating_model: Fixed-premises workshop, NOT mobile. All work performed indoors at Klemzig under controlled lighting and climate. This constrains realistic catchment radius — suburb selection should weight drive-time from Klemzig (inner-north / inner-east / north-east) above far-south metro.

competitive_landscape.notes: MEASURED (Phase 3b, corrected from the Phase 0 pre-data estimate): this is a WEAK-AUTHORITY market. Competitor Domain Authority: ceramicar.com.au 15, adelaidepaintprotection.com.au 13, elitefinish.com.au 12, adelaideautomotivedetailing.com.au 10, madcoupe.com.au 3, eyecandydetailing.com.au 2, svautosalon.com.au 1. No rival exceeds DA 15. Head-term difficulty is correspondingly low — 'paint protection adelaide' and 'ceramic coating adelaide' both return KD 0, 'window tinting adelaide' KD 3, 'ppf adelaide' KD 7. The Phase 0 note that incumbents held 'years of accrued authority' and that head terms were a 12-month play was written before DA data existed and is WRONG. Head terms are genuinely contestable inside 12 months.
competitive_landscape.excluded_pending_escalation: adelaidedetailinggarage.com.au — the owner's former employer and closest structural competitor. Warehouse shows status 'active' while the BDM brief calls them an ex-client. Excluded from seed_competitors by analyst decision until the conflict is resolved.
competitive_landscape.dominant_player: adelaidepaintprotection.com.au (DA 13) holds a top-3 organic position on 3 of the 4 head terms (ceramic coating adelaide, paint protection adelaide, ppf adelaide) — the single most important organic rival, and one the client named in Q16 only as a bare phrase.
competitive_landscape.local_pack_finding: Google shows a local pack on 31 of 42 probed SERPs (74%). For a DA-0 business with no GBP review base, the local pack is the fastest realistic route to visibility — this materially raises the value of the GMB deliverable relative to organic content.

source_counts.gsc_status: DEGRADED — no GSC property exists for glossstudioadl.com.au. Analyst approved proceeding degraded at preflight. Quick-wins track is unavailable for this run.
source_counts.statement: Allocation derived from 9 sitemap URLs + 4 nav service categories + 39 client-declared suburbs across 6 named rings (/areas.html) + 18 DataForSEO Adelaide-level volume probes + a 22-keyword structural reference portfolio recovered from Adelaide Detailing Garage. GSC contributed 0 queries and 0 pages — no property exists, so no demand signal from the client's own search history was available. Tier weights below reflect measured Adelaide search demand, not questionnaire emphasis.

data_gaps: GSC unavailable — no quick_wins track, no impression-based demand validation, no striking-distance detection.
Owner name missing from the questionnaire (Q3 and Q9 both returned ABN-lookup dumps) — blocks E-E-A-T reasoning on author/expertise signals.
No Google rating or review count — GBP appears new or unclaimed; review-vocabulary mining in Phase 1 will lean on competitor reviews instead.

NAP CONFLICT: questionnaire Q8 states Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:00pm / Sat 9:00am–3:00pm; the live site footer and /areas.html state Mon–Fri 8am–5pm / Sat 8am–3pm. Must be resolved before GBP and citation work.

correction_log.reason: Phase 0 asserted incumbents had years of accrued authority. Phase 3b measured DA 1-15 across all 7 competitors and Phase 3a returned head-term KD 0-7. The original claim would have wrongly pushed Phase 5 away from head terms.

package.suburb_source: data-driven (scored over the client's 39 declared suburbs — analyst decision at Phase 0)

service_tiering.rationale: Highest measured volume inside the client's actual service set. MEDIUM competition. Also carries a genuine SA-regulatory content angle (VLT limits) that supports topical depth.

Best opportunity ratio in the entire probe set — 720/mo at competition index 15 with the highest CPC ($6.08). High commercial value against almost no paid competition. Independently matches the silo Adelaide Detailing Garage built its ranking portfolio on.

The client's brand-anchor service — homepage title leads with it and GYEON authorised-partner status is the strongest credential they hold. Volume is solid but HIGH competition (71) makes the head term a 12-month play at DA 0; suburb-level entry is the realistic route.

Distinct service with its own page, named first in the client's Q13 preference, and the highest CPC in the set ($6.12). Generic 'paint protection' outsells the film-specific term 4:1, so PPF earns a general slot but NOT a location silo.

50/mo at competition index 86 — too thin for a general slot in a 40-keyword package and too thin for a location silo. Covered as a secondary keyword on the ceramic-coating and paint-protection pages, where it is a genuine upstream prerequisite service.

silos.rationale: Highest-volume suburb head term available. Chosen over 'car window tinting' (590) and 'window tint' (880, same competition profile but weaker modifier breadth).
Chosen over 'paint protection film' (170) and 'car paint protection' (30) — the generic form carries 4x the volume at a quarter of the competition. Matches the ADG reference portfolio exactly.
Brand-anchor service and the second silo in the ADG reference portfolio, where 8 of 10 suburb pages held position 1. Suburb-level competition is far weaker than the head term's index of 71.

location_grid.grid_note: Uniform grid — every selected suburb receives all 3 silos. 12 x 3 = 36 exactly, no bonus keywords needed and no two-pass scoring required.
location_grid.suburb_pool_source: client-declared /areas.html (39 suburbs, 6 named rings), scored data-driven in Phase 2

priors.q17_coverage: all 10 present in the declared pool
priors.adg_coverage: 7 of 10 present (Magill, Mawson Lakes, Norwood, Prospect, Rostrevor, North Adelaide, Campbelltown). Absent from the client's declared pool: Flagstaff Hill, Glenelg North, Seaton — all far-south or west of the Klemzig workshop.
priors.drive_time_note: Fixed-premises operator. Phase 2 scoring should weight inner_north, inner_east and north_east above south_and_other, which sits 20-40 minutes from Klemzig.

general_allocation.eligibility_evidence: sitemap match — /window-tinting.html exists and already targets this term in its title tag; needs depth and SA VLT-regulation content rather than a new page.
sitemap match — /paint-protection-film.html exists but is titled to the film-specific term; retargeting it to the 4x-higher-volume generic is an optimisation, not new content.
sitemap match — /ceramic-coating.html exists and the homepage title also targets this term; a title-collision check is required in Phase 4.

sitemap match — /paint-protection-film.html is the natural home for the film-specific term once the generic moves to the paint-protection head; resolves an internal title conflict rather than creating a page.

quick_wins.reason: Requires GSC. No property exists for this domain — unavailable for this run.

existing_page_optimisation.reason: All 4 general keywords map to service pages that already exist on the live site.

category_gap_fill.reason: The site has zero suburb pages. Every location keyword requires new content.

geo_expansion.reason: Requires a template_proven cluster with at least one ranking page. The client has no rankings — the domain is ~3 months old with DA 0.

tracks.deviation_note: The fresh-client default split is 45% existing_page_optimisation / 45% category_gap_fill / 10% geo_expansion, which on 40 keywords would be 18/18/4. Actual classification is 4/36/0 because track eligibility is a factual test against the sitemap, and only 4 optimisable pages exist. Classified on fact rather than forced to the default ratio.

brand_defence.reason: config.include_brand_defence = false. Queries containing 'Gloss Studio' belong to the reputation / AI-overview monitoring track, not the organic keyword track.

near_me.reason: config.include_near_me = false. 'Near me' variants belong to the GBP local-pack track. With only 4 general slots, a near-me variant would displace a service head term.

default_exclusions.summary_line: Default-excluded: 0 brand-defence (tracked in reputation), 0 near-me (tracked in GBP local pack) — both suppressed at source by config flags rather than generated then stripped. Set include_brand_defence or include_near_me in config.json to opt these back in.

third_party_brands.phase_0_finding: Adelaide-level volume probes returned NO measurable volume for 'xpel adelaide', 'gyeon ceramic coating adelaide' or 'tesla ceramic coating adelaide'. Brand-prefixed terms are zero-volume at this geography. Carriage is genuine and confirmed in questionnaire Q21, so they remain eligible as secondaries and as on-page trust signals, but none should win one of the 4 general slots.

analyst_decisions: 4th general slot: 'ppf adelaide' (170/mo) chosen over 'paint correction adelaide' (50/mo) and 'car detailing adelaide' (1600/mo). Car detailing was rejected as off-service — questionnaire Q12 lists only the 4 protection services, so ranking for it would attract work the client does not sell.

Suburb pool: score the client's 39 declared suburbs data-driven rather than running open Adelaide-metro discovery. Respects the catchment the client has publicly committed to on /areas.html while keeping selection evidence-based.
